text:
hana: Quick Q  renting a car for client visits next week. Is CDW/LDW covered by Redwood if I book on a personal card? Also: do we reimburse mileage if I drive my own car to the client site from home?

rob_people_ops: Short answer: preferred flow = book rentals through the Travel Portal on the corporate card. Portal rentals include our negotiated CDW when available. If you must use a personal card, you can be reimbursed but CDW purchased on a personal card is not automatically covered by Redwoodit requires pre-approval. For personal-card rentals, save the itemized rental invoice and the CDW line, and request manager + People Ops approval on the expense report.

megan: For mileage rates  what's the per-mile amount?

rob_people_ops: We reimburse personal-car business mileage at the company mileage rate (matches the current IRS standard). Check the Travel & Expense page for the up-to-date cents-per-mile value. Log miles in your expense report with start/end locations and attach a short trip note. Personal commutes (home->office) are not reimbursable; home->client site is reimbursable.

dan_manager: Approving Hana for the rental. Hana, note that GPS, roadside assistance, and upgrades need manager pre-approval if they add > $20/day.

rob_people_ops: Fuel & tolls: gas receipts and tolls are reimbursable with receipts. If the rental was prepaid with a fuel option, include the folio; we may request justification if the fuel option looks excessive.

hana: If I lose a toll receipt or parking stub, is card statement ok?

rob_people_ops: For small items (<$25) we accept the card statement line + a short note + manager attestation. For larger amounts or multiple missing receipts, use the Lost Receipt Affidavit in Expensify.

hana: Thanks! I'll try the Travel Portal first and otherwise upload the invoices and a pre-approval note.
